さらにビームウィングにはラメクリアイエローの特別カラーを採用。

en: black color
Metal Lugal Lumon is born!
Metal Garurumon (Black Ver.) from "Digimon Adventure" appears in Figure-rise Standard Amplified! Reproduced with coloring inspired by the popular black version.
◆ Reproduced with molding color inspired by black version
Based on the image of the black version, the coloring based on black and white is reproduced with molded colors.
Furthermore, the beam wing uses a special lame clear yellow color.
◆ The movable gimmick of each joint block allows display in a wide range of poses.
The included action base allows for dynamic poses.
◆ Delivered in full color PKG!
